fixture: Production HTTP application and Chromium/software WebGL. New circle review uses 1,125,000 original observations independently constructed on an analytic curved tunnel, with known inward/outward departures. It checks local-axis viewing/reversal, side selection, exact-coordinate separation, reviewed removal, Undo, cancellation and immutable original hashes. Existing shape, deleted-point and bundle workflows are exercised separately.
algorithm: A smooth local 3D centreline and moving perpendicular frames; three thin-section guide refinements followed by robust angularly balanced circle fits in default 5 m windows at 50% overlap. Supported offsets/radii blend between windows. All retained source observations are classified in bounded blocks with 64-bit IDs. Fitting uses bounded disk-backed calibration samples; that sample budget is not an input admission limit.
acceptance: Final fit requires at least 240 degrees of angular support, at least 45% circle consensus, and fitted-support RMS no greater than 35% of the tighter inward/outward keep band. Neighbouring unsupported fits leave the affected points unassessed and retained. Constructed half-wall and oval examples are deliberately rejected. These checks do not establish field or survey accuracy.
semantics: Preview changes no scan and preselects no departures. Inward is toward the fitted tunnel centre, outward is away from it, independent of viewing direction. Selection, removal and separation use full-density original point IDs. Workspace Undo reverses source masks and child creation. Previous cleaning methods remain available.
recovery_limit: Good lining excluded by earlier cleaning must be restored before fitting. Permanently removed observations cannot be reconstructed by this update.
